Keep "not ready" and ask the author to finish the self-review checklist, including the AI policy item. Someone should also check #39598 before spending reviewer time here.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Please finish the self-review checklist in the PR description, including the AI use policy item, and say how you tested this manually. The [guide on submitting a pull request](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html) explains what each item means.
```
